ext_name.message: BnBridge – Bridge your rates across platforms and years

ext_description.message: Export, import and carry over your Airbnb and Vrbo calendar prices, from one platform to another and from one year to the next.

unsupported_intro.message: The extension works on a listing's calendar, on one of these sites:

notice_not_calendar.message: This page is not a listing's calendar. Open it to read or change prices:

import_hint.message: Import expects a .bnbprices file exported by the extension, from this listing, another one, or another supported site.

export_tip.message: Export the prices read into a .bnbprices file, to import later on this listing, another one, or another supported site.

base_help_aria.message: What the base price is for

base_help_tip.message: The site's default rate, the one of nights you never touched. When applying, a night at this price gets changed; a night at any other price counts as customised and is left alone. It also fills periods without a rule in the projection.

special_days_hint.message: Checked days get their own price rule per period; the others share one.

rules_title.message: Rules inferred from the source year

share_help_tip.message: Share of the period's nights that were at the chosen price. 100%: every night had this price. Less: prices varied within the period and the most frequent one was kept.

mode_project.message: Carry the $1 rates over to another year

mode_as_is.message: Apply the $1 rates as they are

err_page_unresponsive.message: The page is not responding: open an Airbnb or Vrbo calendar, or reload the tab
